Scope: collector and local roads, potable water, sewerage, storm drainage, irrigation, medium-voltage, street lighting and telecom networks, a sewage pump station and storm drainage ponds for Block J. Contract value 117.4M SAR excluding VAT, 24 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At the 13-Oct-2026 data date the project is 54.8% complete against 85.3% planned, behind by 30.5% (SPI 0.64). The weekly report states 3.4% gained this week against 1.4% planned.

The project is forecast to finish about seven and a half months late. The weekly report and the P6 update (data date 20-Oct-2026) both forecast completion on 31-Aug-2027, 232 days after the contract completion date of 11-Jan-2027. The P6 completion milestone has −189.5 days of float. With 87.7% of the contract time used, 45.2% of the physical work remains, and every network completion milestone is between 124 and 207 days negative in P6.

Data notes

Only the files in the latest upload (W3) were used.

  • Data dates differ: the weekly report (report 92) is dated 13-Oct-2026, while the P6 update, the failed-start list and the PDF exports are dated 20-Oct-2026. This report uses 13-Oct-2026 as its data date and shows P6 figures as of 20-Oct-2026.
  • Week 91 is counted from site handover (12-Jan-2025 to 13-Oct-2026 is 639 days), matching "contract week 91 of 104" in the report's milestone sheet. The workbook itself is numbered report 92.
  • The four P6 PDF exports (Level 5, look-ahead, WBS summary, remaining works) could not be converted to text, so they were not used.
  • On the report cover the physical progress by WBS is shifted by one row (Earthworks shows Irrigation's man-hours, and so on). The figures were taken from the Progress sheet, where they line up with the P6 table.
  • The Arabic summary sheet labels 85.79% planned and 75.76% actual as "progress". These are cost-based earned value. Physical progress is 85.32% planned and 54.81% actual.
  • The "weekly" physical progress on the cover (603 man-hours planned, 1,493 earned) equals the whole October month-to-date in the Physical-Chart Data sheet. Weekly earned value (2,593,776 SAR) also equals the October figure. The "this week" values may therefore be month-to-date.
  • The "Last week vs this week" sheet is still based on the P6 updates of 21-Apr and 28-Apr-2026, so it was not used.
  • The physical forecast in the chart data reaches 100% in January 2027, which contradicts the forecast completion of 31-Aug-2027.
  • Network totals in the Arabic summary sheet do not match the Major Quantities sheet. For example, potable water is 12,200 LM against 9,720 m of pipe, and medium voltage is 17,328 LM against 19,500 m of cable. The summary also gives 100% supply for MV and street lighting, while the procurement log shows MV cable at 68% and RMUs and luminaires at 0%.
  • The summary sheet gives site handover as 12-Feb-2025 (12-Jan-2025 in the weekly report). Its milestone dates also differ from the weekly report baseline: for example, roads 20-Dec-2026 against 21-Oct-2026.
  • The procurement log has deliveries above the required quantity: sewer GRP 400 mm SN5000 1,060 of 261 m, irrigation 110 mm couplings 322 of 58, and telecom spacers 5,500 of 4,405. The 250 mm coupling has a required quantity of 0. Two asphalt units read "m132" and "m133".
  • Manual head count is 152 on the cover, 154 in the trade table, and 113 in the cover's trade total, which leaves out drivers and operators. The next-month manual forecast of 1,148 looks wrong, and the weekly manpower rows repeat the same values.
  • The HSE inspection sheet covers 26-Aug to 01-Sep-2026, not this week.
  • Several cover fields show #REF! (EAC, top issues). The invoice log has stray values of 21,100,000 and 20,900,000 under revised contract value and EAC.
  • Storm drainage is 33,717,565 SAR in the Arabic summary sheet and 33,717,595 SAR in invoice 19. The latter matches the BOQ total.
  • The earthworks milestone has a baseline of 24-May-2026 but was finished on 31-May-2025. The look-ahead sheet gives an expected finish of 22-Feb-2026, which is already past.
  • Photos: one upload is a duplicate, one is too small (384 px), and one is a framed presentation graphic ("MODON 2 — Steel Reinforcement Works"). These were not used.
